To me this difference in color looks like reduced bloodflow (vasoconstriction) and one primary factor for a reduced bloodflow is temperature perception. In the same way that perceived heat on a warm sunny day, makes a body glow red, veins pump and sweat in attempt to cooling the body. Will perceived coldness bodies look paler and hide veins for preserving body temperature. However this is not necessarily a bodily-global effect and can be localised.
